D. Cross-linking of DNA

This patient most likely received cisplatin, which is used for bladder cancer and is classically associated with ototoxicity, causing tinnitus and sensorineural hearing loss.

Cisplatin works by forming DNA cross-links, which inhibits DNA replication and transcription, leading to cell death.
